name: quick-reply
description: Reply to parts of an answer: comment on blocks inline, or quote a selection with > on an empty prompt line

tmuxEnter.title: tmux: Enter saves without scrolling
tmuxEnter.description: Inside tmux, bind Enter (in the running server, not your config) to send Shift+Enter while a comment is armed, so saving it doesn't scroll to the end. Skipped if Enter is already bound or extended-keys is off.

editorLauncher.title: Editor: how to open it
editorLauncher.description: How /quick-reply-edit opens your editor. auto uses tmux if you're in it, else kitty if it's listening for remote control, else the command below.

editorCommand.title: Editor: command
editorCommand.description: For the command launcher: the editor's command line, with {file} for the buffer's path. It must wait until the editor quits, e.g. nvim-qt --nofork {file}.
